hypotheses.O1_qkv_is_competitive_with_human: At equal 21-category and 128-type budgets, QK/value-derived categories are within 0.03 joint KL recovery of the human categories.
hypotheses.O2_qkv_beats_embedding_only: QK/value-derived categories exceed embedding-only categories by at least 0.05 joint KL recovery.
hypotheses.O3_qkv_beats_random: QK/value-derived categories exceed random token categories by at least 0.20 joint KL recovery.
hypotheses.O4_a_learned_ontology_improves_human: At least one model-derived ontology exceeds human-category joint KL recovery by at least 0.03.
hypotheses.O5_a_learned_ontology_is_prediction_fait: At least one model-derived ontology retains at least 0.75 native top-1 agreement.
